overview.title: Architecting High-Velocity Engineering Squads for Global Scale
overview.summary: ThinkWires was established in 2022 to dismantle the structural bottlenecks of traditional IT staffing. Operating across high-demand tech corridors in India, the United States, and Canada, we combine the domain depth of an executive search firm with the rapid scalability of an aggregator ecosystem.
overview.mission: To engineer frictionless, compliant, and hyper-targeted talent pipelines that enable technology leaders to build and scale world-class software teams without borders.

aggregatorModel.heading: The ThinkWires Aggregator Model
aggregatorModel.description: Traditional recruitment agencies bottleneck on internal databases. ThinkWires functions as an enterprise staffing aggregator orchestrating a high-velocity ecosystem of verified partner agencies, independent specialists, and automated compliance pipelines.

cards.title: Rapid Profile Delivery (5 Hours)
cards.description: Proprietary matching algorithms search verified repositories to deliver pre-screened, job-fit candidate dossiers within 5 working hours of intake.
cards.detail: Guaranteed sub-5-hour SLA response with benchmarked technical scorecards.

cards.title: Full-Stack Tech & Enterprise ERP
cards.description: Specialized domain depth spanning SAP ABAP/HANA, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Teamcenter PLM, Kubernetes/DevOps, and Generative AI frameworks.
cards.detail: Pre-vetted engineering squads ready for immediate deployment into enterprise stacks.

cards.title: Compliance & EOR Infrastructure
cards.description: Complete Employer of Record (EOR) indemnification. We manage local statutory payroll, benefits, strict IP NDA assignments, and multi-jurisdiction tax withholding.
cards.detail: Bulletproof legal governance covering Indian statutory mandates, US W2/1099, and Canadian labor regulations.

cards.title: Agile Subcontractor Network
cards.description: A curated network of certified boutique recruitment partners providing instant surge capacity without inflating fixed operational overhead.
cards.detail: Elastic scaling framework enabling enterprises to mobilize specialized benches on demand.

philosophy.heading: "Recruitment is Not Transactional; It is Architectural."
philosophy.description: At ThinkWires, we reject the legacy headhunter pattern of resume-dumping. We treat every client intake as an engineering brief. From understanding the nuances of microservices architectures to navigating localized tax laws in Ontario or California, our teams engineer frictionless, compliant talent conduits.

leadershipTeam.heading: Meet Our Leadership Team
leadershipTeam.subheading: Driving cross-border vision, recruitment architecture, and operational integrity across global technology corridors.

growthTimeline.heading: Our Growth Evolution
growthTimeline.description: From an agile aggregator in Sector 63, Noida to a cross-continental staffing architecture powering Fortune 500 engineering initiatives.

milestones.title: Foundation & Model Inception
milestones.description: Founded in Noida with a core team dedicated to borderless recruitment, pioneering an agency aggregator network that delivers verified profiles in under 5 hours.

milestones.title: Growth & Practice Alignment
milestones.description: Unit economics break-even achieved. Launched specialized talent practices across SAP ABAP/HANA, Cloud/DevOps, and Enterprise Salesforce consulting.

milestones.title: Cross-Border Expansion
milestones.description: Inaugurated dedicated talent corridors into the United States and Canada. Rolled out comprehensive Employer of Record (EOR) and global payroll management.

roadmap.title: AI-Powered Delivery & Telemetry Vetting
roadmap.description: Automated code telemetry vetting, generative talent search matching, and sub-48-hour global deployment pipelines across AI and PLM systems.

methodology.heading: How We Work: From Spec to Squad
methodology.description: Our three-step framework eliminates recruitment friction and guarantees rapid technical alignment.

steps.title: Discovery & Technical Scoping
steps.description: We initiate with an executive discovery session. We evaluate tech stack nuances, project deadlines, budgetary constraints, and candidate seniority to draft exact success metrics.

steps.title: Precision Pre-Vetted Match (<5 Hours)
steps.description: Our aggregator engine coordinates across our specialized subcontractor network to deliver tested, pre-interviewed candidate dossiers within five working hours.

steps.title: Frictionless Onboarding & Governance
steps.description: Seamless offer negotiation, local statutory contract issuance via EOR, compliant equipment provisioning, and ongoing governance tracking ensure long-term retention.
steps.deliverable: Full EOR Indemnification & Ongoing Performance Governance
